description: The fatal open arm. The case declares no ACCTFILE input at all, which is how it states that the account master is not there to be opened - a dataset a case says nothing about is omitted from "inputs" entirely. 0000-ACCTFILE-OPEN at app/cbl/CBACT01C.cbl:L133-L149 moves 8 into APPL-RESULT before the OPEN, sees a status other than '00', moves 12, and takes its ELSE arm: DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING ACCTFILE', then MOVE ACCTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS and 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, then 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM. The status is rendered through the extended branch at L177-L183 because its first byte is '9', giving FILE STATUS IS: NNNN9000, and the CALL 'CEE3ABD' at L173 carries APPL-RESULT 12 out as the RETURN-CODE. No record is read, the closing banner at L85 is never reached, and nothing is written anywhere.
